Unity provides a platform for 3D games, apps, and experiences, but the sheer volume of documentation can make learning the engine challenging. The company used Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service to build Muse Chat, an AI assistant that can guide creators through common questions and help troubleshoot issues to make game development easier.
